meta.parties: Babun Nona Et Al. v. Starrex

rules.statement: In the case of a contract to pay a sum of money upon the happening of a certain event, prescription does not begin to run until the event has occurred.
rules.supporting_quote: "A contract to pay a sum of money upon the happening of a certain event, where the amount payable had to be determined in a certain way by the defendant with the assent of the planters, the statute of prescriptions would be inoperative until the particular event has occurred."
